title_or_table: Annual Estimates of the Resident Population by Single Year of Age and Sex for the United States: April 1, 2020 to July 1, 2025 (NC-EST2025-AGESEX-RES)
observation_period: July 1, 2025, with the April 1, 2020 estimates base
qualification: Estimates built from the 2020 Census with births, deaths and migration since; each new vintage revises earlier years, and the top age row groups everyone 100 and over

age.description: single year of age; 100 is 100 and over

printed_source_line: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, Vintage 2025 population estimates, resident population by single year of age and sex, July 1, 2025, United States. Retrieved November 11, 2026. Estimates are revised with each vintage; the top row counts everyone 100 and over.
domain_note: The reader question asks how many people are near the ages for Social Security and Medicare, programs V7 places under taxes, wealth and economic security

source_line_variants.with_program_ages: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, Vintage 2025 population estimates, resident population by single year of age and sex, July 1, 2025, United States. Retrieved November 11, 2026. Estimates are revised with each vintage; the top row counts everyone 100 and over. Program ages from the Social Security Act, 42 U.S.C. 402(a) and 426(a), read November 12, 2026.

notes: Program ages for S53’s note, read November 12, 2026 (maker B’s RB-R3): 42 U.S.C. 402(a) (United States Code, 2024 edition) entitles a fully insured individual who “has attained age 62” to old-age insurance benefits, and 416(l)(2) defines “early retirement age” as “age 62” for an old-age benefit; 42 U.S.C. 426(a) entitles to hospital insurance (Medicare Part A) an individual who “has attained age 65” and is entitled to Social Security or railroad retirement benefits; medicare.gov, Get started with Medicare: “Medicare is health insurance for people 65 or older who meet citizenship or residency requirements. You may be eligible to get Medicare earlier if you have a disability, End-Stage Renal Disease (ESRD), or ALS”. ssa.gov refused this container (HTTP 403)
